title: Zane Whitfield (9): carry and pass at 1'
summary: At 1', Zane Whitfield takes the kick-off, drives forward with a decisive carry and plays a neat pass to Cole Toure.
explanation: Whitfield collects the restart, uses his first touch to drive into space and completes a strong carrying run before laying the ball off to Cole Toure. It's a tidy early sequence that shows his speed and control, making it a brief highlight even though it doesn't immediately lead to a chance.

title: Zane Whitfield (9): shot saved at 2'
summary: Zane Whitfield intercepts possession, drives forward and sees his long-range shot saved at 2'.
explanation: Whitfield wins an interception, carries the ball into space with a couple of touches before attempting a long-range effort that the keeper keeps out. It's worth watching for the quick transition from defence to attack and his confidence to shoot from distance.

title: Zane Whitfield (9): shot at 4'
summary: Zane Whitfield fires a shot that is saved at 4'.
explanation: Zane Whitfield gets a shooting chance and his effort is kept out by the goalkeeper, so it doesn't find the net. It's worth watching because it was a goal-looking attempt that forced a save and shows Whitfield testing the keeper.
